howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以访问 golden-chat-topics 的 Discord 聊天记录，从中查找解决方案、代码片段、团队决策、故障排查步骤以及共享链接和资源。
howto.when: 当用户询问与 golden-chat-topics 聊天历史相关的问题，例如需要查找过去讨论过的解决方案或参考代码时触发。

say.text: 在 golden-chat-topics 的聊天记录里找一下设置步骤。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 setup 相关消息。

say.text: 帮我查查 golden-chat-topics 里关于故障排查的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会检索 troubleshooting 部分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access the golden-chat-topics Discord chat history to find solutions, code snippets, team decisions, troubleshooting steps, and shared links and resources.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks questions related to the golden-chat-topics chat history, such as looking for past solutions or referencing code snippets.

say_en.text: Find the setup steps in the golden-chat-topics chat history.
say_en.note: Claude will search for setup-related messages.

say_en.text: Look up troubleshooting discussions in golden-chat-topics.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the troubleshooting section.
